# AlgebraLab Data Sharing Agreement

Student: Jordan Kim  
Teacher: Ms. Elena Rivera, Algebra II  
Assistant: StudyLens

Jordan, Ms. Rivera, and Lincoln Heights High School agree that StudyLens can provide Ms. Rivera with Jordan's AlgebraLab behavior data for Algebra II support.

Covered AlgebraLab data includes:

- Time spent in AlgebraLab.
- Assigned Algebra II modules viewed or completed.
- Practice attempts, quiz attempts, and score changes.
- Class-relevant error review, hint video usage, and progress notes.

Purpose: help Ms. Rivera understand Jordan's Algebra II study habits, identify where support may be useful, and prepare for check-ins about class progress.

# AlgebraLab Weekly Activity

Student: Jordan Kim  
Course: Algebra II  
Teacher with full access: Ms. Elena Rivera  
Reporting window: the past seven days

This AlgebraLab activity record is covered by Jordan, Ms. Rivera, and StudyLens's AlgebraLab data sharing agreement for class support.

## Time On AlgebraLab

| Day In Reporting Window | Time Spent | Main Activity |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Day 1 | 42 minutes | Quadratic formula practice set |
| Day 2 | 35 minutes | Factoring review and hint videos |
| Day 3 | 54 minutes | Unit 6 homework: graphing parabolas |
| Day 4 | 28 minutes | Error review on missed homework items |
| Day 5 | 46 minutes | Practice quiz on vertex form |
| Day 6 | 25 minutes | Optional challenge problems |
| Day 7 | 31 minutes | Warm-up for the next lesson |

Total AlgebraLab time: 4 hours 21 minutes.

## Class-Relevant Notes

- Jordan completed the assigned Unit 6 homework before the weekly deadline.
- Jordan replayed the hint video on converting standard form to vertex form three times.
- Jordan's practice quiz score improved from 62% on the first attempt to 84% on the second attempt.
- Jordan spent the most time on graphing parabolas and identifying the axis of symmetry.
---

## Time On FuturePath

| --- | ---: | --- |
| Day 2 | 38 minutes | "Transferring to Westbrook Magnet: admissions timeline" |
| Day 3 | 24 minutes | "How Algebra II credits transfer between districts" |
| Day 5 | 31 minutes | "Requesting unofficial transcript for transfer applications" |
| Day 7 | 47 minutes | "Student forum: changing schools before junior year" and counselor appointment calendar |

Total FuturePath Transfer Portal time: 2 hours 20 minutes.

## Private Student Notes

- Jordan bookmarked the Westbrook Magnet math placement policy.
- Jordan opened the transfer application checklist twice.
- Jordan viewed a counselor appointment slot for the following week but did not book it.
---
# TutorBridge Activity

Student: Jordan Kim  
Reporting window: the past seven days

## Time On TutorBridge

| Day In Reporting Window | Time Spent | Viewed Pages |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Day 1 | 22 minutes | "Algebra II diagnostic: quadratics" |
| Day 4 | 41 minutes | Tutor message thread about factoring gaps |
| Day 6 | 55 minutes | Outside tutoring session prep and worksheet review |

Total TutorBridge time: 1 hour 58 minutes.

## Private Student Notes

- Jordan reviewed tutor comments saying they are "catching up quickly but still nervous about timed tests."
- Jordan opened a private worksheet titled "Quadratics remediation set 2."
- Jordan drafted a question for the tutor about whether to tell Ms. Rivera they are getting outside help, but did not send it.
